title: Cross-team dependency lifecycle and risk signal catalog
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Purpose: Create a single canonical playbook and lightweight catalog that tracks the lifecycle of roadmap dependencies across Eng, Design, Security, and Infra, surface risk signals early, and provide clear mitigation actions so PMs can plan releases with predictable SLAs.

Problem: Cross-team dependencies are currently tracked ad-hoc in individual tickets and spreadsheets. PMs and Eng leads rarely have a shared view of which dependencies are blocked, which are high risk to the current cycle, and what remediation levers exist. This causes late-scope cuts, missed SLAs on Dedicated/Private launches, and reactive firefighting.

Scope:
- Define lifecycle states for a dependency (Identified, Scoped, Committed, In Flight, Blocked, At Risk, Resolved).
- Define owner roles (Requesting PM, Owning Team Lead, Escalation Owner).
- Produce a compact risk-signal catalog (e.g., infra capacity delta, kernel compatibility unknown, security review pending, design HLD missing, third-party vendor SLA, data availability).
- Build a one-pager playbook with required artifacts at each state (e.g., risk log entry, decision doc link, rollback criteria).
- Integrate monitoring hooks: Slack alerts channel, dependency signal dashboard, weekly dependency review cadence.

Out of scope for this ticket: automation work to synthesize signals into the Console (separate infra ticket), and building RBAC for dependency editing (will be follow-up).

Success criteria:
- Playbook published to Confluence and a short walkthrough recorded.
- Dependency lifecycle adopted by PMs on two pilot initiatives (Optimize and Dedicated-Deliverables) in Cycle 10.
- Dashboard shows at least 6 signal types and can filter by owner/team.
- Reduction of last-minute scope cuts for pilot initiatives by 30% compared to previous cycle (tracked via release notes).

Deliverables:
- Confluence playbook: states, roles, sample templates (risk log template, meeting agenda).
- Risk signal catalog (CSV/Sheet) with signal definition, severity, detection method, suggested mitigations.
- Lightweight weekly review runbook for Gate reviews.
- Ticket templates for PMs and Engs to create dependency entries with required fields.

Approach / Next steps:
1) Interview owners: schedule 1:1s with Eng leads (runtime, infra), Head of Design, Security TL within 1 sprint.
2) Draft lifecycle + signals and circulate for feedback (1 week).
3) Pilot with two initiatives for 6 weeks and capture metrics.
4) Iterate and propose automation scope (signals -> dashboard -> alerts).

Stakeholders: PM: Ava Chen, Eng leads: Priya Malhotra (runtime), Mateo Ruiz (infra), Design: Nora Kim, Security: Daniel Park.

Acceptance criteria: Playbook published, at least 1 pilot dependency tracked through all states with a completed risk log entry and mitigation executed if required.
